name: Voxel Material Palette Generation
definition: A system that maps voxel values (1-255) to PBR materials for each of the 6 voxel faces, packing material layer indices and flags into a 2D texture atlas and a lookup palette.
summary: Voxel Material Palette Generation creates compact lookup tables mapping voxel values to PBR materials, reducing memory overhead by batching materials into atlases instead of using per-voxel instances.
